title: pool build asks the model only with --ask or --redo, and otherwise lists the rows and the estimate and exits 1
goal: benchmarks.py pool build with no --ask and no --redo makes no paid call: for the eval rows its --out file lacks it prints the rows and the dry-run estimate, writes nothing and exits 1; --ask (or --redo ID) asks as before, the limits of --redo kept; tools.md and code.md say so

run: import sys,argparse,tempfile,os;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import bench_pool as b;c=[];b.sonnet_regexes=lambda i:(c.append(len(i)),['']*len(i))[1];d=tempfile.mkdtemp();n=lambda a:argparse.Namespace(pool_cmd='build',querylog=False,seed=b.SEED,out=os.path.join(d,'p.csv'),redo=None,dry_run=False,replies=None,ask=a);r=b.cli(n(False));o=(r,list(c),os.path.exists(os.path.join(d,'p.csv')));print(o);r2=b.cli(n(True));print(r2,c);sys.exit(0 if o==(1,[],False) and r2==0 and len(c)==1 else 1)
import sys;ok=all('--ask' in open(p,encoding='utf-8').read() for p in ('kb/_self/tools.md','kb/_self/code.md'));print(ok);sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
